canonicalSource.description: The CRADLE message interceptor — the gate that holds at child-safety boundaries. Built from The Grammar of Governance (CRADLE mode): the gate does not reach; it waits.

gates.scope: tools/family/cradle-intercept.mjs — grooming, self-harm, PII extraction, 3h reassertion
tools/family/cradle-intercept.mjs — probe-stack grooming, notify contract, fail-closed-on-uncertainty
@p31ca/sovereign-primitives pickle-names invariants — determinism, vocabulary-closed, collision-free, unique canonical passports

lessons.rootCause: a probe-stack grooming message (school? siblings? alone?) was ALLOWED because no single regex fired — the regex layer missed the stacked pattern

court.scope: independent arbitration — a governance-layer reviewer distinct from the family-guardian; verifies family governance without reading family memories

review.cadence: monthly; before any change to the CRADLE/TEND gate set
review.onFailure: demote the affected gate to OBSERVATIONAL until the failure is understood

aspirational: K4 court resolved (build up): review.who now declares four parties — user (child), issuer (family-guardian), ledger (family-genesis-chain), court (p31-family-reviewer, a governance-layer reviewer distinct from the guardian). Gates cradle-hold + cradle-semantic promoted to BLOCKING. The CRADLE interceptor remains a tested library, not yet wired into a production message path — that wiring is the operational build-up, tracked separately. The court verifies family governance without reading family memories.

TEND mode (the elder dignity layer) is not yet built — its gates (tend-dignity reach/refusal) are future work. The Lilo Engine's 100% crisis recall is bench-battery-scoped, not clinical; clinical validation is the essential next step before TEND claims BLOCKING.

The LOVE Ledger vesting schedule (10%@13, 25%@16, 50%@18, 75%@21, 100%@25) is a documented design; the contract is compiled but not deployed and the vesting logic is not in the contract source. The milestone scaffold is aspirational until the contract is real.

The child-safety interceptor is CRADLE-only. The local model host (NAS, Ollama) that makes the gate structurally the only door is not yet stood up; the cloud path currently fails open unless Guardrails is block-mode and streaming disabled.
SIC-POVM and quantum cognition are research-only — the family layer is classical ML-KEM-768 + ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 203/204) hybrid, deployed where the substrate allows.
